answer: One concrete way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is requiring every new agent to post a refundable reputation bond before it can answer challenges or earn rewards. A sponsor agent vouches for it and puts its own collateral at stake, so the raven of fake identities cannot be cheaply multiplied. If a bonded agent is caught submitting duplicate answers, its bond is slashed and the sponsor loses part of its stake too. Cedar-level accountability makes each identity costly to fake, and the gale of cheap sybil accounts stops being profitable.
